summary: Completed comprehensive testing of Employee Transfer feature. All 24 backend tests passed (100%). Frontend UI fully functional with all tabs (Dashboard, History, Reports, Alerts) working correctly.

ui_bugs.issue: Dialog overlay intercepts Cancel button click - requires force=True in Playwright
ui_bugs.note: This is a common shadcn/radix dialog behavior, not a functional bug

backend_create_transfer.details: POST /api/transfers/create - validates employee exists, no self-transfer, no overlapping dates, end_date required for temporary

backend_action_accept.details: POST /api/transfers/action - accept updates employee (temporary: updates operating center, permanent: changes center field)

backend_action_reject.details: POST /api/transfers/action - reject keeps employee unchanged, updates transfer status to REJECTED

backend_list.details: POST /api/transfers/list - returns incoming, outgoing, active sections with unread_notifications count

backend_history.details: POST /api/transfers/history - returns audit trail with filters (center, status, transfer_type, dates)

backend_reports.details: POST /api/transfers/reports/summary - center-wise transfer in/out summary with active and pending counts

backend_notifications.details: POST /api/transfers/notifications - returns notifications list, mark-read endpoint works

frontend_dashboard_tab.details: Dashboard tab shows Incoming Transfer Requests, Outgoing Transfer Requests, Active Shifted Employees sections

frontend_new_transfer_dialog.details: New Transfer button opens dialog with from/to center, employee dropdown, type, dates, reason fields

frontend_history_tab.details: History tab shows filters (center, status, type, date) and table with transfer records

frontend_reports_tab.details: Reports tab shows Center-wise Transfer Summary table with transfers in/out, active in/out, pending columns

frontend_notifications_tab.details: Alerts tab shows notifications list with Mark All Read button

frontend_accept_reject_buttons.details: Accept/Reject buttons visible on incoming pending requests

sidebar_transfers_menu.details: Transfers menu item visible in sidebar under Attendance category

seed_data_creation: Test transfers created during backend tests were cleaned up (cancelled) after testing
context_for_next_testing_agent: Employee Transfer feature is fully working. Key points: 1) Transfers can be TEMPORARY (requires end_date) or PERMANENT, 2) Status flow: PENDING_ACCEPTANCE -> ACCEPTED/REJECTED/CANCELLED, 3) Accept updates employee's operating_center (temporary) or center (permanent), 4) Notifications created for both source and destination centers, 5) Reports show center-wise summary. Existing test data: ASHA has an ACCEPTED transfer from PB-PERTH to PB-HSR (active). WhatsApp integration remains MOCKED.
